meta.import_notes: Schedule trigger every 15 minutes on Make Free (Free plan minimum interval is 15 minutes — do not use 10). Paid plans may use 10 minutes if product requires tighter dispatch. Query Follow_ups where status=Pending AND send_at <= now. For each row, re-check Lead_Log + Config before send. Cancel/skip rules must match shared_modules.md. Band A: keep this scenario OFF while Free slots are used by Web Form + Manual Test Sheet intake.

flow.label: Every 15 minutes (Free minimum; paid may use 10)
flow.notes: Make Free: minimum schedule interval is 15 minutes. Do not set 10 on Free.

If paused: optionally cancel-all Pending with skip_reason=system_paused OR leave Pending (prefer leave Pending so they fire after unpause only if still within product rules — IA8 default: SKIP send this run, leave Pending; if paused > touch window client may cancel manually). Documented default: do not send while paused; leave Pending.

routes.name: cancel_terminal
routes.filter: Lead.status IN [OptOut, Replied, Won, Lost] OR Lead.opt_out = TRUE

routes.name: skip_error_paused
routes.notes: Paused: leave Pending (no send). Error: Skipped with reason lead_error

routes.name: send
routes.filter: Lead.status IN [Texted, FollowUp] AND opt_out = FALSE

flow.label: If now outside quiet hours, bump send_at forward and keep Pending
flow.notes: Dispatcher may catch row at night if clock skew; roll send_at and skip send this cycle.

cancel_rules_summary: On Reply/STOP/Won/Lost: Scenario 5 (or manual status change) should cancel ALL Pending Follow_ups for that lead_id. Dispatcher also defensive-cancels if it sees terminal status.
